interpretations.label: Total Mid-Year Population
interpretations.description: Total de jure or de facto population of a country estimated at mid-year.
caveats: Census schedules and definition standards vary by country
Historical figures rely on demographic back-projections

interpretations.label: Urban Population
interpretations.description: Total population living in urban areas as defined by each country's national statistical office.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Count of persons residing in urban localities (Unit: persons)
caveats: National criteria for defining urban areas are inconsistent globally

knownRisks: Border changes and geopolitical dissolutions/formations between 1960 and 2024
Differing frequencies and reliabilities of historical national censuses
